stem: Susan needs a better transition from the third paragraph (sentences 15–20) to the fourth paragraph (sentences 21–25). Which of the following can be added to the beginning of the fourth paragraph, just before sentence 21, to strengthen this transition?

options.label: F
options.text: This ability to communicate in person becomes even more important as teenagers get older.

options.label: G
options.text: In a few short years, most teens in our school will be entering the job market or college.

options.label: H
options.text: Learning to read people’s communication cues will help build opportunities for teens.

options.label: J
options.text: In a business setting, a teen will need to know how to understand his coworkers.
